prompt: In this photorealistic photo, a bustling farm scene unfolds under the midday sun. On the far left stands a farmer in a blue flannel shirt holding a pitchfork upright. Next to him is a rusty red tractor with large rear tires. A brown dog sits on the tractor's step, looking toward the center. In the center foreground, a woman in a yellow sundress kneels beside a wooden crate filled with golden corn cobs. She is handing a cob to a boy in denim overalls who reaches out eagerly. Behind them, an older man in a straw hat points at the horizon. To his right, a black cow grazes near a split-rail fence. Leaning against the fence is a teenage girl in a green hoodie watching the cow. Further back on the right, a man in a white t-shirt lifts a heavy hay bale onto a trailer. A gray cat perches on the trailer's edge, observing the lift. Beside the trailer, a young child in a pink dress clutches a teddy bear tightly. Near the child, a rooster with bright red comb pecks at the ground. In the background left, a barn with peeling white paint looms large. A ladder leans against the barn wall. On the roof of the barn, a person in orange safety gear repairs a shingle. Below the ladder, a bucket of tools rests on the dirt. Near the bucket, a pair of work gloves lies discarded. In the distance, a windmill spins slowly against the sky. There is no modern machinery like combines visible in the frame. There is no rain or storm clouds in the sky. There is no electronic equipment such as phones or tablets present.
